topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: When I heard the news about Sam moving across the country, a whirlwind of thoughts swept through me. It's a big step, a bold leap into the unknown, and I can't help but admire the courage it takes. Part of me feels a tug, a wish to hold on to the way things are, but another part sees the adventure waiting for Sam. I want to be the friend who stands at the edge of this new chapter, cheering them on, even as the road stretches long and uncertain ahead. It's a time for change, and though it's hard, I know deep down, it's also a time for growth. We'll find new ways to laugh together, to share the triumphs and the struggles. Change is just the universe’s way of ensuring our stories keep unfolding, and I'm ready to see what new pages this turn writes.
